decisions.I2_LIVE: SUPPORTED_IN_DECLARED_SCOPE: same19-option development comparison improves gap by0.05335; six coffee wins and two losses. This is repeated-development static cross-grader evidence, not fresh product confirmation.
decisions.final_bundle: Archived inner-selected C11/ridge0.3 candidate; selected outer results are a nested procedure, not the all-development final model independently tested. Do not replace its selection by the observed outer winner after seeing scores.
decisions.head_refit: INCONCLUSIVE: same-input old-head gap0.50837 to selected refit0.49261; paired95%CI[-0.04244,0.00534]. NDCG improves, positive-mention CE worsens slightly; selected frozen A0 gap0.48181 remains better on primary metric.
decisions.human_review: 12 existing source cases retained for optional semantic/process review, answers blank; no new questionnaire or professional tasting labels; Claude/DeepSeek not called
decisions.interaction: NO_IMPROVEMENT over I2_LIVE alone: joint patch/acquisition interaction gap +0.02076. New mapped B can change coverage-selected options and add competing directly expressed descriptors that disagree with held grader T.
decisions.leakage_repair_attribution: Five records have a full-A direction absent from actual Q0/Q1. Removing that unavailable input changes zero complete old-full-A versus LIVE question trajectories at the R6 fixed budget on this cohort. The boundary repair is valid; do not claim the leak caused the observed score difference.
decisions.mapping: NO_MEANINGFUL_EXACT_ALIGNMENT_IMPROVEMENT: mapping-alone gap benefit only one coffee group through fixed partial credit; exact Recall/NDCG unchanged. Keep verified rules as source interpretation, do not adopt the whole patch-driven acquisition scheme as better product behavior.
decisions.new_sources: No new independent collection admitted in R6. Targeted source work reused actual R5 A/B and checked lexical scope; seven dictionary references cached privately.
decisions.next_evidence: Independent coffee groups with authentic initial/later sensory observations plus fixed independent T, providing distributed incremental B-to-T agreement under the same19-option bank. More mapped words alone did not increase the eight exact B-to-T overlaps.
